plan.planning_summary: Refining route_02 based on iteration history showing performance degradation from 0.7407 (iteration 05) to 0.5776 (iteration 08). Feedback directives specify: (1) reinitialize from iteration 05 best candidate seed, (2) restrict thickness bounds to 45-120 nm to prevent >140 nm drift observed in iteration 08, (3) reduce optimizer step-size by 50% for gentler convergence. Four complementary routes proposed: baseline seed reinitialization with tightened bounds, reduced layer count (20L) for manufacturability, increased layer count (28L) for performance ceiling exploration, and robustness-weighted optimization to address robustness score degradation.

routes.title: Seed-Reinitialized Bounded Optimization with Damped Step Size
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Reinitializing the optimizer from iteration 05's best candidate (target_score 0.7407) with thickness bounds restricted to 45-120 nm and 50% reduced step size will recover or exceed the iteration 05 performance while eliminating the >140 nm thickness drift that caused iteration 08 degradation.
routes.design_principle: Use verified high-performing thickness profile as optimization seed; enforce strict bounds to prevent drift into non-productive thickness regimes; reduce step size to avoid overshooting local optima in the decoupled spectral response regime.
routes.proposed_topology: 24-layer alternating stack starting with HfO2 on fused silica substrate, ending with SiO2 at air interface. Exact sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 800-1500 nm band
Maximize mean reflectance in 200-400 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness bounds 45-120 nm compatible with standard deposition monitoring
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for coherent multilayer interference
Gradient-based thickness optimization with bounded variables
Seed initialization from previously verified high-performing candidate
expected_advantages: Faster convergence from verified seed point
Elimination of thickness drift beyond productive regime
known_risks: May converge to same local optimum as iteration 05 without improvement
Tight bounds may prevent discovery of better solutions outside 45-120 nm range
Reduced step size may require more optimization iterations
routes.execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Initialize thicknesses from the iteration 05 best candidate: [94.52, 44.39, 105.43, 125.49, 60.29, 139.57, 57.24, 132.67, 118.56, 65.78, 125.97, 50.46, 126.63, 57.34, 121.89, 87.85, 135.60, 58.91, 115.89, 87.90, 116.43, 63.74, 72.20, 76.02] nm. Apply strict thickness bounds of 45-120 nm to all layers (clip initial values outside bounds to nearest bound). Use gradient_thickness optimizer with step size reduced to 50% of default value. Spectral objectives: maximize mean transmittance over 800-1500 nm band, maximize mean reflectance over 200-400 nm band. Assume normal incidence, unpolarized light. Evaluate robustness with ±15 nm absolute normal thickness tolerance. Total layer count fixed at 24. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 200-400 nm, 800-1500 nm. soft objectives: High transmission in 800-1500 nm band; High reflection in 200-400 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low transmission in 200-400 nm band; Low reflection in 800-1500 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layers <= 30; Materials limited to HfO2 and SiO2.
routes.revision_reason: Reset optimizer using iteration 05 best candidate (score 0.7407) as seed; restrict bounds to 45-120 nm to eliminate >140 nm drift observed in iteration 08; reduce step size by 50% per feedback directives to enforce gentler convergence.

routes.title: Reduced Layer Count (20L) with Tight Bounds for Manufacturability
routes.scientific_hypothesis: A 20-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack with thickness bounds 45-120 nm can achieve comparable dual-band performance to the 24-layer design while improving manufacturability through reduced deposition time and fewer interface defects.
routes.design_principle: Reduce layer count to test performance-layer count tradeoff; maintain same material system and spectral objectives; use tighter bounds to compensate for fewer degrees of freedom.

Maximize mean reflectance in 200-400 nm band

routes.design_principle: Increase layer count toward the 30-layer limit to explore performance ceiling; maintain same material system and spectral objectives; use same bounds as route_02_refinement_01 to ensure fair comparison.

routes.title: Robustness-Weighted Optimization with Seed Reinitialization
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Explicitly weighting robustness in the optimization objective while reinitializing from iteration 05 seed will recover target performance while preventing the robustness score degradation observed in iteration 08 (0.4026 to 0.4015).
routes.design_principle: Multi-objective optimization balancing spectral performance and thickness tolerance robustness; use verified seed from iteration 05; maintain 45-120 nm bounds to prevent drift.
routes.proposed_topology: 24-layer alternating stack starting with HfO2 on fused silica substrate, ending with SiO2 at air interface. Exact sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2
